timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): interest earned ₹3,029.99 Cr, net profit ₹421.83 Cr (+34.9% YoY).
Punjab & Sind Bank’s Board, led by Saket Mehrotra, recommended a final dividend of 3.90% (₹0.39/share) for FY 2025-26, pending AGM approval on April 27, 2026.
On April 27, 2026, Punjab & Sind Bank reported Q4 and FY26 financial results with net profit growing 30.12% YoY to ₹1,322 Cr.
Punjab & Sind Bank shared the audio recording link for its Analyst Meet on Q4 FY2026 results held on April 28, 2026, via Saket Mehrotra.
On April 28, 2026, Punjab & Sind Bank hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, reporting record annual net profit of ₹1,322 Cr and total business of ₹2,63,652 Cr.
On May 7, 2026, Punjab & Sind Bank reported receiving a strike notice from the All India PSB Officers Union for May 8, 2026.
Q1FY27 results (standalone): interest earned ₹3,213.37 Cr (+10.4% YoY), net profit ₹331.51 Cr (+23.2% YoY).
Punjab & Sind Bank presented Q1FY27 results and guided FY27 advances growth of 16-18%, deposits at 13-14%, and GNPA under 2.0%.
Punjab & Sind Bank hosted its Q1FY27 earnings call, targeting 18-20% credit growth and 2.60-2.65% NIM for FY27.
On July 28, 2026, Punjab & Sind Bank held its 16th AGM, where shareholders approved the FY26 audited accounts and the dividend of ₹0.39 per share.
On August 22, 2026, Punjab & Sind Bank informed the exchange that CARE Ratings reaffirmed the CARE AA; Stable rating on its Tier II bonds totaling ₹1,237.30 Cr.
Punjab & Sind Bank released its corporate investor presentation in September 2026 detailing business growth and digital transformation.
Punjab & Sind Bank received a strike notice from the United Forum of Bank Union for an All India Strike on September 11, 2026.
CRISIL Ratings reaffirmed CRISIL AA/Stable rating on Punjab & Sind Bank's ₹4,000 Cr total bonds.
Punjab & Sind Bank received notice from UFBU proposing an All India Strike from September 28 to September 30, 2026.
On September 29, 2026, Punjab & Sind Bank approved raising up to USD 1 billion via a Medium-Term Note Programme.
Punjab & Sind Bank reported provisional total business of ₹2,79,328 Cr for Q2FY27, up 15.77% YoY.
On October 5, 2026, Fitch Ratings assigned Punjab & Sind Bank a first-time Long-Term IDR of 'BBB-' with a Stable Outlook.
India Ratings reaffirmed Punjab & Sind Bank's ₹3,000 Cr infrastructure bonds at IND AA/Stable on October 6, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): interest earned ₹3,394.48 Cr (+13.2% YoY), net profit ₹411.97 Cr (+39.9% YoY).
Punjab & Sind Bank reported Q2FY27 standalone net profit of ₹412 Cr, up 39.66% YoY.
Punjab & Sind Bank hosted an Analyst Meet on Q2/HYFY 2026 results via recording on October 19, 2026, per SEBI (LODR) Regulation 30.
On October 27, 2026, Punjab & Sind Bank filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on October 19, 2026.
